name: Nord Lead 3
description: Nord Lead 3 virtual analog synthesizer: every control of its manual's MIDI controller list, under its sections.

sources.title: Nord Lead 3 User Manual, OS v1.2x
sources.notes: MIDI controller list (pages 145, 146, 147, 148 of the PDF) read by tools/profiles/nord/read-nord-cc.mjs from Nord Lead 3 English User Manual v1.2 Edition 1.2x.pdf (sha256 8f42e9e78818c33a9ec83a206d2ab83ce2d798df3f23bd9a6fa3896ca1c3ec18), https://www.nordkeyboards.com/wt/documents/223/Nord%20Lead%203%20English%20User%20Manual%20v1.2%20Edition%201.2x.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/nord/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/nord/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI controller list, with its printed name, sent as the control change it prints on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The list prints controller numbers only: every value is 0 - 127, and a setting chosen from a list (a model, a waveform, an effect type) is a number here, not a choice.
The manual: every parameter uses the whole 0 - 127, a button's or selector's range divided into equal sections, one for each of its settings.
The list's third column, the General MIDI name of each controller number, is kept in the descriptions.
Left out, the pedals, the wheel and bank select: 1 Modulation Wheel.
